content: Melikisetekia ala agi hanea kanoe.

Amitegeno Apalahamua tuma hifiti alia afenona alitalu huteno tenia (10) hetama vai-malefiti nago hetama Melikisetekina amine. Melikisetekie agimoa tagai kefina Fatago kavakeya nehia sauve kanoe. huno humaine. Salemu kumale haya agimoa tagai kefina Aipamoa falu humainea sauve kanoe. huya hu-mainayane.

Omainayanagita tagaya ago havimainone Anumayatimoa Yuta nofi vayapiti falote hu-maineanagino Mosesea ani nofi vayafena Mono notela kava vaya maiho. huno hu oamateneane.
